Cottage & woodland · IDEA 01

Toadstool Terrace

CONCEPT ONLY · NO PRINT FILES

A wide mushroom cap shelters a circular seed terrace, with a low central stem hopper instead of a miniature house.

This is an unbuilt design study. No CAD, STL, STEP, 3MF, print time, filament weight, price or physical test result is available. It is not ready to print, order or reserve.

Compare all four concepts

Shortlists stay in this browser. Nothing is submitted and no vote count is claimed.

How this could work

Design intent, not a claim that these mechanisms have been engineered or tested.

Different on purpose

A broad low cap over a narrow stem and annular deck; no castle shell or repeated box chassis.

Feeding system

Proposed gravity feed through a small metering outlet into a removable ring tray. Seed-flow dimensions are not yet set.

Refill & cleaning

Lift off the cap for refill; remove the entire ring tray for washing. Keep cap release separate from the structural hanging path.

Mounting approach

Proposed hanging design with a continuous structural spine. Hanger strength and balance remain engineering work.

Proposed print breakdown

Target: cap, hopper/spine and removable ring tray. Part count and plate fit are not validated.

Tests before this becomes a product

  1. Dry and damp seed bridging at the metering outlet
  2. Ring-tray removal without releasing the hanging structure
  3. Drain access, cap rain shedding and suspended load

Before any download release: finish measured CAD, verify every connected solid and drain, arrange the real parts on plates, run a native slicer roundtrip, then perform fit, cleaning, seed-flow and load trials.

Why explore this direction?

Etsy Fall/Winter 2026 trend report (2026-10-14). Adjacent-market context, not proof of feeder demand.

Our theme-to-feeder interpretation is a hypothesis. A familiar aesthetic does not establish purchase intent, and the illustration is not a customer review or licensed collaboration.

Original geometry and naming should remain independent of protected characters, logos, book covers and recognizable franchise props.
